description: This file defines the custom exception class `LoanTransactionNotFoundException` used in the loan account module of the Fineract project. It extends a generic resource not found exception and provides multiple constructors for different ways to specify a missing loan transaction, including by ID, external ID, and with underlying exceptions.

classes.name: LoanTransactionNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a loan transaction resource was not found. Extends a general resource not found exception and provides context-specific constructors.

methods.name: LoanTransactionNotFoundException(String msg)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a specific message key and message.

methods.name: LoanTransactionNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs the exception indicating a transaction with a specific ID does not exist.

methods.name: LoanTransactionNotFoundException(Long id, Long loanId)
methods.description: Constructs the exception indicating a transaction with a specific ID does not exist for a given loan ID.

methods.name: LoanTransactionNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a cause, indicating a transaction ID was not found in the database.

methods.name: LoanTransactionNotFoundException(ExternalId transactionExternalId)
methods.description: Constructs the exception when a transaction with a specific external ID is not found.

methods.name: LoanTransactionNotFoundException(ExternalId transactionExternalId, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a cause for a missing external transaction ID.
